msIdentifier.msName: tshad ma rnam 'grel le'u gnyis pa'i 'grel ba

support.p:
32 folios, numbered from 75 (not visible; but 76 is visible on the next folio) to 106.
Extensive use of abbreviations.

adminInfo.note: Among the items with signature "phyi zha 21" listed in [8H6M69W4], this instance could correspond to No. 16375. [8H6M69W4] reports 106 folios, which corresponds to the folio number on the last folio of this 32-folio instance. However, [8H6M69W4] reports for No. 16375 the title "tshad ma rnam par nges pa'i Tik+ka las rang don le'u," the author "ye shes dpal ste chos kyi ye shes min nam snyam brtag," and the script "dpe tshugs," size "61.5 x 8 cm" whereas the present instance bears no indication of authorship and the contents relate, rather, to the first chapter of the Pramāṇaviniścaya (ID:3774). The first words on fol. 75a - 'di las rang don le'ur bstan pa'i... - could have influenced the editors of [8H6M69W4].

bibl.title: tshad ma'i bsdus pa
ཚད་མའི་བསྡུས་པ
tshad ma rnam 'grel le'u gnyis pa'i 'grel ba
tshad ma'i rnam 'grel le'u gsum pa'i rnam bshad
bibl.author: Anonymous
bibl.note:
Part of an epistemological work. The text starts on fol. 75 in instance (ID:4774), suggesting that it is part of a longer treatise. The initial discussion addresses the number of valid cognitions, the definition of valid cognition and its object. The text ends on a discussion on the certitude of co-apprehension (lhan cig dmigs nges). The available portion of the work covers in particular the definition of the objects of cognition (yul kyi mtshan nyid) and the different sorts of objects (yul kyi dbye ba), of which it distinguishes the three, gzung yul, zhen yul, 'jug yul.
[Z5WBK2VV]: 66 reports the title "tshad ma rnam 'grel le'u gnyis pa'i 'grel ba." BUDA gives the title "tshad ma rnam 'grel le'u gsum pa'i rnam bshad." According to [J4L5X9AG]: 434-435, it is a kind of summary rather than a commentary on either the Pramāṇaviniścaya (ID:3774) or the Pramāṇavārttika (ID:3772) - hence the editorial title "tshad ma'i bsdus pa." The text post-dates 1219, the date of composition of the Tshad ma rigs gter (ID:5564), which is quoted at least once ( ex045032025-05-2015-12-06 ). It makes numerous references to the interpretation of Devendrabuddhi (ID:5554) and Dharmottara (ID:3780), and to many unidentified figures, likely Tibetan scholars.
